messages:
Mike H: Quick question — I opened a tiny TF PR to add a reservation label to demo-3 slice. Who owns the 'reserved-for' / billing labels in allocator now?
Anya P: I thought infra-alloc did the label, but procurement attached the billing tag last quarter.
Mike H: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/882 — it only adds labels and a note. Want to avoid breaking vendor slot mapping.
Procurement Bot: Heads-up: tagging policy requires both reserved-for AND billing_account labels. See runbook: https://go/redwood/alloc-runbook :memo:
Linh T: I can take this. Will run terraform plan against staging and confirm pool mapping. @Vendor Ops can you confirm which pool this physical slot lives in?
Vendor Ops: That slot is idle in eu-west1, maps to pool-id=eu-dedicated-3. No allocator-side changes needed from our end.
Mike H: Awesome. Also note: nightly demo window 00:30–02:30 UTC. If apply goes well we should be covered.
Oncall Bot: Scheduled change window registered for 2026-03-21 00:30 UTC. Will watch evictions and tokenized metrics for 30m post-apply.
Anya P: If Linh applies, I'll follow with a tiny billing PR to add acct info, unless procurement wants to do it.
Linh T: Assign PR to me and I'll run plan/app. Posting plan snippet shortly.
Mike H: Assigning now — thx.
Linh T: Plan results:
```bash
$ terraform plan -target=redwood_alloc.reservation["demo-3"]
Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ redwood_alloc.reservation.demo-3.labels["reserved-for"] = "demo-3"
+ redwood_alloc.reservation.demo-3.labels["billing_account"] = "acct-987"
```
Linh T: Applying in ~2m. Will post smoke checks.
Vendor Ops: Confirmed: pool binding shows token-route -> eu-dedicated-3, no mismatch.
Linh T: Apply done. Smoke check logs: allocation accepted, ping returned, no evictions in 10m.
Linh T: Smoke snippet:
```
2026-03-21T00:35:12Z INFO reservation.demo-3 status=ACTIVE pool=eu-dedicated-3
2026-03-21T00:36:01Z INFO ping ok latency=18ms
2026-03-21T00:45:12Z INFO eviction-check ok window=10m
```
Anya P: Nice work — I'll open the billing PR with acct-987 and link here.
Procurement Bot: Noted. When billing PR merged, the finance ticket will auto-update.
Mike H: Great coordination, thanks everyone. Closing the loop — will mark the demo booking in calendar. :thumbsup:
